authorityBoundary: Norn owns graph document semantics, graph layout, graph interaction, fallback behavior, and plugin ABI behavior. Eve owns only plugin manifest, advertisement, ABI, provider requirement, and conformance export contracts.

moveSets.replacementProof: Norn publishes norn.graph plugin manifest and advertisement from the Norn repo or sidecar daemon.
Norn owns embed.norn layout, interaction, fallback, and ABI conformance cases.

forbiddenImports: provider command acceptance or receipt authority
requiredExternalProofs: Norn publishes the norn.graph sidecar ABI without depending on Eve source layout.
Norn owns graph layout, interaction, fallback, and conformance fixtures.
Providers consume norn.graph through plugin advertisements and ABI operations.
Runtimes declare norn.graph projection support through runtime capability manifests.
